purpose: Gate A closed scalar producer/verifier contract

frozen_model_task.renderer: lm-eval 0.4.11 compatible standard plain non-chat MMLU
frozen_model_task.probe: full rendered Answer: prefix final non-padding token
frozen_model_task.forward: one native zero-loop use_cache=false per identity

choice_admission.required: each surface encodes to one token and all four tokens are distinct
choice_admission.persistence: only booleans and count; token IDs remain in memory

raw_boundaries.definition: B0 embedding output; Bj block j output before FinalNorm for 1<=j<L; BL residual before FinalNorm

raw_boundaries.closure: native final hidden is used for BL after the one native FinalNorm call; BL is never normalized twice
